### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #23648

Problem Summary: RENAME USER is not supported by TiDB, this PR adds support for it.

### What is changed and how it works?

What's Changed: Added RENAME USER

How it Works: RENAME USER <from_user> TO <to_user> [, <from_user2> to <to_user2> [...]]
Renames one or more users ('user'@'host'). Similar code as DROP USER, to cover all internal mysql.* tables that are related.

Either the whole command succeeds or nothing is done, i.e. there will be no users that are renamed in case of error for other users. Everything is done in a single transaction, which is rolled back on error.

### Related changes

- PR to update `pingcap/docs`/`pingcap/docs-cn`: TODO.

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- Unit tests
- Integration tests
- Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)
  - CREATE USER, RENAME USER only by name, both name and host, non existing.

Side effects

None.

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

- TiDB now supports the `RENAME USER` statement. This helps improve compatibility with MySQL.

issue_context.body:
## Feature Request

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe:**

```sql
mysql [localhost:8023] {msandbox} (test) > create user first;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.01 sec)

mysql [localhost:8023] {msandbox} (test) > rename user first to second;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)

mysql [localhost:8023] {msandbox} (test) > show grants for second;
+------------------------------------+
| Grants for second@%                |
+------------------------------------+
| GRANT USAGE ON *.* TO `second`@`%` |
+------------------------------------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)
```
In TiDB:
```sql
mysql> create user first;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)

mysql> rename user first to second;
ERROR 1064 (42000): You have an error in your SQL syntax; check the manual that corresponds to your TiDB version for the right syntax to use line 1 column 11 near "user first to second" 
```

**Describe the feature you'd like:**

See above. I noticed this while porting tests for dynamic privileges - I don't have an active need for it.

**Describe alternatives you've considered:**

N/A


**Teachability, Documentation, Adoption, Migration Strategy:**

MySQL compatibility.

review_comments: Calling `ExecRestrictedStmt` can simplify this block because it doesn't need to process `recordSet`.

`userExists()` uses `ExecRestrictedStmt` and it would not see already made changes (updates) to the system table. I assume since it using its own transaction?
That is the reason I added the userExistsInternal, to use the same `SQLExecutor`/transaction. Is that possible with the `ExecRestrictedStmt`?
No, `ExecRestrictedStmt` uses another session. I got it.
Execute `drop user if exists ...` before creating. Otherwise, the test case may be affected by other cases in the future.
There are 9 system tables to modify. Maybe you can put the params in an array and iterate the array to simplify the code?

I agree, and that is why I also [added a comment](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/24413/files#diff-96117c390a5a6cfe0ea63921e2252de41e74ea40e00da756907c7b55876e0197R1141) about it.

Do you want me to add the refactoring of DROP USER and the new code in this PR or in a separate PR?
